title: discord-event-bot events.json
description: One message a day, at dailyAt, lists today's events in one Discord channel through a webhook. Times are Vietnam time (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

dailyAt.description: Time (HH:MM, Vietnam time) of the daily message that lists today's events. Default 08:00.

title.description: Bold headline of the event in the daily message.

time.description: "HH:MM" for daily. "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" or "DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM" for weekly and monthly: the date sets the weekday (weekly) or the day of month (monthly). The time is shown next to the title.

role.description: Who to ping in the daily message when this event is on: a role alias declared in the DISCORD_ROLES environment variable (e.g. "dev"), "everyone" or "here". Never a role id. Omit for no ping.

message.description: Extra text shown under the title.

image.description: Optional https:// link to an image, shown large under the message.

link.description: Optional https:// link to the event page, shown as a clickable 'Xem chi tiết sự kiện'.

until.description: Optional last day the event is listed (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Omit to repeat forever.

type.description: Optional. in-game = done inside the game; off-game = outside the game (website, restaurant, offline meetup).
